speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific pattern to the rash, such as scaling, blistering, or redness, and does it affect other parts of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face, upper body), sensory neuropathy in the palms, and risk factors including livestock exposure (hepatitis C/hepatitis B association) and potential hemochromatosis is highly suggestive of PCT. Confirming this requires liver function tests and porphyrin levels. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests, Urine_Porphyrins, Serum_Porphyrins. REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_Lesion_Close_Up.
